title: Bis-3-chloropiperidines: a novel motif for anthelmintic drug design
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,824-831
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA05699J, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Michael Kirchner, Michael Marner, Tim Kramer, Felix Mühlemeyer, Johanna Eichberg, Markus Oberpaul, Simone Haeberlein, Richard Göttlich
We report the in vitro screening of bis-3-chloropiperidine derivatives against the free-living Caenorhabditis elegans and the parasitic Schistosoma mansoni. 56% of compounds active against C. elegans were also active against S. mansoni.
